meaning:
ἀνα-τέλλω
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;]
1. trans., to cause to rise: Mat.5:45.
2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Mat.4:16 (= Isa.9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Mat.13:6, Mrk.4:6 16:2, Jas.1:11; νεφέλη, Luk.12:54; φωσφόρος, 2Pe.1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, Heb.7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will…
